accepted.evidence: Platts explicitly labels safed “white” Persian and records vernacular vowel variants. The existing Persian safēd node supplies the immediate lexical donor for these Hindi attestations; final t and ph for f are retained as survey adaptations. This is a loan analysis, not inheritance from cognate Sanskrit śveta.
